note: Covers the whole south end of spring-fed Hemlock Lake (to 100 ft deep, stocked with bass, bluegill, perch and trout) near Marcellus. Mostly a seasonal park: lakefront seasonal guests put in their own docks, while short-term campers may tie up a boat or canoe at the two big docks. Cabins and a lakefront cottage are also rented. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026) + its Campspot engine: only 4 short-term RV sites (water + 30 A, $45 a night; Campspot $49.80 for 2027-06-15, max 38 ft) and 3 tent sites ($35); the rest seasonal ($2,600-2,700/season); holidays 3-night minimum; booked on Campspot. Changed hookups electric 50 -> 30, sewer cleared; sites max_rig_ft 50 -> 38, pull_through cleared; added fees 45 and Campspot booking. Note rewritten (the old one claimed 77-85 big-rig sites with sewer/50 A and daily/weekly/monthly transient rates, none on the operator's pages). Not stated: season dates, facilities. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Grand Rapids 101 km); the family has not stayed here.

The entry's old note put the park at ~77-85 sites, so under 1 site in 10 is sold nightly: fails long-stay test 4.
